episode_summary: In this episode, Paul Salter discusses the dangers of constant availability in real estate and the importance of recalibrating routines to maintain balance and effectiveness. He emphasizes the need to prioritize self-care and family time to prevent burnout and sustain long-term success. Salter provides actionable advice on auditing calendars and leveraging intentional limitations to drive innovation and creativity.
